annotations.text:
BUILT FROM THE REFERENCE

context/design/pendant-screens-ref.png is the source of truth. Every screen here is that layout at true size, 240 x 240, over artwork rendered for the panel.

Backgrounds are seven small bitmaps: a base plate, three tints (sent, not sent, blocked) and three wallpapers. Icons are stroke SVG on a 24px grid. Type is Manrope, with IBM Plex Mono for the hash.

WHAT THE FIRMWARE NEEDS

Bitmaps: 7 x 112 KB RGB565 via LVGLImage.py.
Fonts: Manrope 800 at 66 and 54, 700 at 22-26, 600 at 17-20, 500 at 12-15; Plex Mono 500 at 15. Add U+2248 (the approx sign) to the glyph range; everything else is ASCII.
Progress arc, spinner and pills are native LVGL objects.
The lit segment on Main is a pre-rendered layer.

Two screens are new to the firmware: Receive uses the GET PUBLIC KEY display flag the transport already has; Quick actions needs a menu and a recent list.

NEXT: ARC REACTOR FACE

An animated reactor ring as the screensaver, read as a GIF from the SD card (free now the motor is gone; LVGL decodes GIF natively from FAT). Drawn as an original glowing core, not the film prop.

Planned in context/plan/pendant-ui.md after these screens.
